description: Implement a story using Basinfy SaaS Studio collaborative loop
---

Read `.claude/skills/saas-dev-story/SKILL.md` or `.agents/skills/saas-dev-story/SKILL.md`.
Read the active sprint plan at `production/sprints/` and find the target story in `production/epics/`.
Enforce PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) on all database tables and verify Stripe webhook signatures.
Follow the 5-step collaborative loop: Question -> Options -> Decision -> Draft -> Approval.
Before writing or editing code, always ask: "May I write this to [filepath]?"
If the user communicates in Portuguese, render questions and options in Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR).
